prompts.modern:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: SandCore white Aurora theme desktop logo wallpaper, landscape16:9, target3840x2160.
Image1 is a SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY for the new SandCore two dune crest strokes and round core. Use that simple two-wave silhouette, but discard its glow and shading entirely.
Create an understated, beautifully composed brand wallpaper. Soft pearl-white background with very pale ice-blue atmospheric shading across the bottom and upper-left, almost white. ONE compact FLAT SandCore emblem, right of center around (68% width,47% height), 18% of image width. The two dune strokes have crisp edges and a uniform tasteful deep muted teal fill; the core is a small flat sand-gold circle. Clean negative space between the shapes. No perspective, no 3D thickness, no bevels, no metallic material, no glass, no radial halo behind the mark.
A single extremely subtle broad translucent pale-blue sweep crosses the lower third of the background. It supports the composition and never intersects or wraps around the emblem. Large quiet left area for icons. Elegantly restrained design with very strong brand silhouette and deliberate proportions, the quiet design confidence of a beloved classic OS wallpaper.
Do not use turbines, crystals, diamonds, ornaments, sparkle, neon, large glowing blobs, glossy objects, lensflare, chrome or detailed render effects. No text, letters, watermark or Windows logo. ONE finished wallpaper, not a logo sheet or mockup.
prompts.modern_dimensional:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: SandCore Aurora logo desktop wallpaper, refined candidate.
Image1 is the APPROVED edit target. The user approves this restrained design and wants ONLY A LITTLE more refined rendering reminiscent of the polished logos in classic 64-bit workstation OS wallpapers.
Preserve EXACTLY the simple two-dune crest silhouette, round sand-gold core, relative proportions, location, pearl-white/light-blue background, lower soft wave, and generous left-side empty space. Do not redesign the symbol.
Change ONLY the emblem material slightly: quiet satin cyan surfaces, a very narrow soft cool-white highlight along the upper curve edges, extremely shallow dimensional rounding, a subtle natural difference between lit top edge and shaded lower edge, the core a softly luminous warm gold disc with just a small gentle upper highlight. Subtle diffuse shadow immediately behind the logo, barely visible. Still almost-flat, graceful graphic brand art. The enhancement should feel like exceptionally restrained industrial design, not glass or chrome.
Keep the emblem crisp and simple at thumbnail size. No extruded thick geometry, no glowing halo, no glass transparency, diamond, turbine, metallic strips, lens flare, stars, sparkling particles or ornament. No letters or watermark. Single finished16:9wallpaper, target3840x2160.
prompts.classic:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: SandCore Classic pixel desktop wallpaper with late-twentieth-century false-color aesthetics.
Image1 is the edit target. Preserve its composition, teal desktop field, sparse repeating tiny dune motif, the large right-center SandCore two-dune emblem and round core, and especially the crisp chunky pixel staircase edges.
Change ONLY the color treatment of the central emblem to a beautifully balanced nostalgic 1980s/1990s low-color computer palette: upper dune cool cyan and ice-white highlights, lower dune muted orchid-magenta with pale pink highlights, warm amber-yellow core. Narrow deep ink-blue pixel shadow and one-step ivory bevel. Restrained flat palette, 12-16 visible colors maximum, no continuous gradients, no antialiasing. The color separation should suggest early computer false-color graphics and old demo-scene art, while remaining tasteful and calm rather than neon.
Background remains flat muted teal; tiny background emblems darker teal, low contrast. Sparse repeating motif should not compete with the central mark. Keep left half easy to use behind icons.
No photorealism, modern glass, shiny metal, blur, glow, bloom, lens flares, realistic light, typography, wordmark, UI or watermark. Single finished16:9pixel wallpaper.
